findings.summary: The implementer's report states 'Tests for the change were written and run,' but the diff touches only scripts/convert-pdfs.py and scripts/lib/clean.py — no test files. This repo has zero Python test infrastructure at all (pyproject.toml lists no pytest/test dependency, there is no tests/ directory anywhere, and `git log` on both files shows no test file was ever committed for them). The claim is unverifiable from the diff and appears false; none of the four behavior changes (OCR-off, widened spaced-caps regex, entity-unescape/comment-strip ordering, blank-line collapse) has any automated check backing it.

findings.summary: The comment block explaining html.unescape ('Docling's markdown export HTML-escapes literal & < > ... unescape so the embedded text is human-readable... Runs before quote normalization') sits directly above the HTML-comment-stripping regex `re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", ...)` (line 35), while the comment explaining comment-stripping ('Docling emits a "<!-- image -->" placeholder... Strip all HTML comments BEFORE group_broken_paragraphs') sits above the actual `html.unescape(text)` call (line 39). Execution order is still correct (strip comments, then unescape, both before group_broken_paragraphs), so this is not a functional bug, but the swapped commentary will mislead anyone reading or later reordering this code.
